objective: Test per-agent reasoning effort on an Opus custom agent and evaluate a lean-effort delta reviewer. This spike covers part of ac5-3 and cannot achieve it alone.
why: ac5-3 is not-verified in the 2026-10-11T22:32Z reconciliation. The plan notes call the per-agent reasoning effort field undocumented, so ac5-3 starts with a spike. No file under .claude/agents/ on dev at 3a31d4e sets an effort field. docs/eval-agents/corpus/rex.json has 10 entries and no delta entry. C4 needs at least five delta entries first. The reconciliation counts 98 delta re-reviews at a mean of 77k tokens. C2 allows lower effort only on Opus delta re-reviews with a prior marker, through a separate agent file. The o5 build slice #1662 is open, so this spike is a second open o5 slice. C6 allows a spike before the build slice, not beside it. The owner waiver is recorded in the plan notes. This slice does not achieve ac5-3. ac5-3 also needs routing of delta re-reviews to the lean agent file, which this slice excludes. After this slice, ac5-3 is partially-verified at best.

include: A spike ticket sets a token cap from the run count and corpus mining. Budget at least 30 Rex runs at k=3, plus k=8 for each changed entry.
Kill criteria: the step 0 payoff gate fails, no effort field works on Opus, or the preset effect test fails. Also stop on any verdict flip or a spent token cap.

Step 0: use the o1 script to count delta rounds that followed a prior Rex approval. Measure their thinking-plus-output token share. Kill the spike if best-case saving is below the 20% noise floor from the #1652 report.

Step 1: CLI 2.1.296 says agent types get their model, reasoning effort and tools from .claude/agents/*.md frontmatter. Confirm the exact effort key. Confirm the minimum CLI version. Cite the CLI string or docs page in the memo.
Record that the Agent tool also has a per-spawn effort option. Explain why C2 still needs a separate agent file. Hooks can see and pin the file. They cannot see or pin a per-spawn option.
Step 2: create a throwaway copy of code-reviewer.md before the headless session starts. Keep the same prompt, model: opus and omitClaudeMd. Set the effort key. Confirm that the transcript shows Opus.
Confirm that apply-agent-routing.sh keeps the effort key and allows the new agent type. Confirm the same behavior in block-agent-routing-drift.sh.
Set the effect test before running evaluations. Thinking or output tokens per review must fall by at least 30% on paired runs of the same entry at k=3. A changed transcript alone is not proof.
Step 3: add at least five delta entries to docs/eval-agents/corpus/rex.json. Use real Rex delta rounds that followed a prior Rex approval.
Candidates: the delta on an advisory-labelled commit that found a new blocking bug (plan notes, What stays as is), and the rex-1289 range bd78903e..9382269f.

Each delta entry has a diff_range from the approved commit to the new commit. Its oracle is confirmed_fix, independent_review or no_contradiction. Never use the Rex delta verdict as the oracle (AgDR-0089).
At least one delta entry must have a confirmed BLOCKING or HIGH defect. If none exists, stop before step 4. If fewer than five delta entries exist, stop before step 4.
Step 4: run /eval-agents on the delta entries at k=3. Use full-effort code-reviewer as the baseline. Use the lean-effort copy as the after variant.

Both eval prompts carry the production delta brief. Include the approved SHA. Include the old..new range. State that a prior approval exists. Include a CI-green stub. Include the linked-issue text. Without these inputs, Rex requests changes on most clean entries and saturates the flip check.
Score the justified verdict for each entry. Score its defect catch. Record its verdict label. A label flip only between CHANGES REQUESTED and COMMENT is reported, but it is not a pass.
Flips use the #1652 definition: an after verdict that never appeared in the baseline runs of that entry. Run each changed entry at k=8.
Keep /eval-agents isolation. Run no tracker or network command. Write no file under .claude/session/reviews/.
Use the o1 reviewers view for each variant. Report first-turn context, thinking tokens, output tokens and total tokens per review, before and after.

Write a spike memo under docs/spike-memos/. Record the field facts, measured numbers, kill-criteria outcome and disposition. Record the exact frontmatter diff of the throwaway agent file. A later build slice must reproduce the measured variant.
Write an AgDR with the decision to adopt or reject the lean-effort delta reviewer. Include the measured numbers.
Write an /eval-agents report under docs/eval-agents/reports/. Include the method, per-entry scores, verdicts and flip count.
On a kill, record the reason in the memo. Record it in the AgDR. The new delta corpus entries still ship.
exclude: A committed lean-effort agent file and any routing of delta re-reviews to it (a later slice, if the spike promotes)
Any change to the code-reviewer.md prompt or its floor block
Delta re-reviews after a blocking finding. They have no prior approval marker and keep the full-effort Rex (C2, ac7-6)
A reviewer model other than Opus (C2)
Review depth tiers and the resume-or-fresh rule (o7)
Any edit to block-unreviewed-merge.sh, block-merge-on-red-ci.sh or another merge-gate hook (C1)
